title.en: News live: shadow minister ‘not going to apologise’ for triple zero test calls during Telstra outage; Australian woman in US arrested by ICE over alleged illegal voting
title.zh: 新闻直播：影子部长称不会为Telstra断网期间拨打三零测试电话道歉；一名澳大利亚女性在美国因涉嫌非法投票被ICE逮捕

summary.en: A shadow minister stated she would not apologize for making test calls to the emergency 'triple zero' service during a Telstra outage, despite warnings against such actions. Separately, an Australian woman was arrested in the US by ICE for alleged illegal voting.
summary.zh: 一位影子部长表示，她不会为在Telstra网络中断期间拨打紧急“三零”测试电话而道歉，尽管有警告称不应进行此类操作。此外，一名澳大利亚女性在美国因涉嫌非法投票被ICE逮捕。

body.en: Anika Wells says it’s ‘very important that people do not make test calls to triple zero’. Follow today’s news live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Telstra outage reported to be cause of Victoria train stoppage There is a long list of cancelled trains on the official V/line site, but the TL/DR is that Victoria’s regional train network has ground to a halt. Due to a radio network fault affecting the network, services are currently unable to operate … Passengers are advised to defer travel where possible. Continue reading...
body.zh: 阿尼卡·威尔斯 (Anika Wells) 表示，“人们不要拨打三个零的测试电话，这一点非常重要”。关注今天的现场新闻 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 据报道，Telstra 停运是导致维多利亚火车停运的原因 V/line 官方网站上有一长串取消的火车列表，但总的来讲，维多利亚州的区域火车网络已经停止。由于无线电网络故障影响网络，服务目前无法运行……建议乘客尽可能推迟出行。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights the importance of respecting established systems and authorities, especially those vital for public safety and civic order. Whether it's emergency services or electoral processes, our actions contribute to the common good when we adhere to the rules designed to protect everyone. Yahweh calls us to be subject to governing authorities,...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻强调了尊重既定制度和权威的重要性，特别是那些对公共安全和公民秩序至关重要的系统。无论是紧急服务还是选举程序，当我们遵守旨在保护所有人的规则时，我们的行为就为共同利益做出了贡献。雅伟呼召我们顺服掌权的，承认他们在维护社会福祉中的作用。

verse.textEn: Let everyone be subject to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which God has established.
verse.textZh: 在上有权柄的，人人当顺服他，因为没有权柄不是出于神的。

title.en: Virgin Media fined £28m for preventing customers from cancelling contracts
title.zh: 维珍媒体因阻止客户取消合同被罚款2800万英镑

summary.en: Ofcom, the UK telecoms watchdog, has issued its largest-ever consumer protection fine of £28m to Virgin Media. The company was penalized for deliberately making it difficult for millions of customers to cancel their contracts over a period of nearly three years.
summary.zh: 英国电信监管机构Ofcom对维珍媒体处以2800万英镑的罚款，这是其有史以来开出的最大一笔消费者保护罚款。该公司因在近三年内故意阻挠数百万客户取消合同而受到处罚。

body.en: Ofcom levies largest-ever consumer protection fine after finding firm deliberately mishandled millions of phone calls Virgin Media has been fined £28m by the UK telecoms watchdog for repeatedly preventing customers from cancelling their contracts over a near-three-year period. Ofcom discovered that Virgin Media “likely mishandled” millions of phone calls between the start of 2022 and autumn 2024, with deliberate call-dropping tactics, unnecessary call transfers and putting customers on hold for “no reason”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 英国通信管理局 (Ofcom) 发现公司故意不当处理数百万个电话后，开出了有史以来最大规模的消费者保护罚款。 英国电信监管机构 Virgin Media 因在近三年内多次阻止客户取消合同而被罚款 2800 万英镑。 Ofcom 发现，Virgin Media 在 2022 年初至 2024 年秋季期间“可能处理不当”了数百万个电话，包括故意的挂断电话、不必要的电话转接以及“无缘无故”地让客户等待。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights the importance of integrity in business, where fair dealing should always prevail. Yahweh detests dishonest practices, reminding us that true prosperity is built on justice and transparency, not on exploiting customers.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻强调了商业诚信的重要性，公平交易应始终是其核心。雅伟憎恶不诚实的商业行为，提醒我们真正的繁荣是建立在公义和透明之上的，而非通过剥削客户。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Labour calls on Farage to ‘come clean’ over £5m gift and work with crime agency over money laundering concerns - UK politics live
title.zh: 工党呼吁法拉奇就500万英镑捐赠“说清楚”，并与犯罪机构合作解决洗钱担忧——英国政治直播

summary.en: Political rivals are calling on Reform UK leader Nigel Farage to explain a £5 million gift, which has been reported to the UK crime agency due to money laundering concerns. The Liberal Democrats have stated that “the game is up” as other parties vow to boycott a byelection.
summary.zh: 英国政治对手呼吁改革党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇就一笔500万英镑的捐赠“说清楚”，该捐赠因涉嫌洗钱已被报告给英国犯罪机构。自由民主党表示“游戏结束了”，其他政党也誓言抵制补选。

body.en: Lib Dems tell Reform UK leader ‘the game is up’ as political rivals vow to boycott ‘stunt’ Clacton byelection Revealed: Farage’s £5m gift reported to UK crime agency over money laundering concerns Ed Davey , the Lib Dem leader, has restated his call for the government to stop Nigel Farage resigning as an MP. In an interview on the Today programme, Davey said: I don’t think there should be a byelection until the investigation [into claims that Farage broke parliamentary rules by not declaring the £5m donation from Christopher Harborne] has completed. The people of Clacton deserve to know whether their MP has broken the rules in a very, very serious way. If you want to resign as an MP, you actually have to apply to the government to have an appointment to an office. And the chancellor actually decides whether to appoint you. Now, normally that has happened. However, there is a precedent going back to 1842 where the chancellor has didn’t appoint someone to one of these positions [steward of the Chiltern Hundreds]. And if that appointment is not made, then Mr Farage can’t resign and the investigation will continue. Continue reading...
body.zh: 自由民主党告诉改革英国领导人“游戏已经结束”，因为政治对手誓言抵制“阻碍”克拉克顿补选。 透露：法拉奇因洗钱问题向英国犯罪机构报告了 500 万英镑的礼物。自由民主党领导人埃德·戴维 (Ed Davey) 再次呼吁政府阻止奈杰尔·法拉奇辞去议员职务。戴维在接受《今日》节目采访时表示：我认为，在调查[对法拉奇未申报克里斯托弗·哈博恩捐赠的 500 万英镑违反议会规定的指控]完成之前，不应该进行补选。克拉克顿人民应该知道他们的议员是否非常非常严重地违反了规则。如果你想辞去国会议员的职务，你实际上必须向政府申请预约办公室。财政大臣实际上决定是否任命你。现在，通常这种情况都会发生。然而，早在 1842 年就有先例，财政大臣并没有任命某人担任这些职位之一（奇尔特恩百人团的管家）。如果没有做出任命，那么法拉奇先生就不能辞职，调查将继续进行。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Allegations of financial impropriety, especially concerning large sums, remind us of the importance of integrity in all dealings. Yahweh's word teaches that faithfulness in small matters reflects faithfulness in larger ones, and dishonesty in little things points to dishonesty in much. This principle calls public figures to transparent and upright conduct,...
reflection.zh: 涉及巨额资金的财务不当行为指控，提醒我们所有交易中诚信的重要性。雅伟的话教导我们，在小事上忠心的人，在大事上也忠心；在小事上不义的人，在大事上也不义。这一原则呼吁公众人物以透明和正直的方式行事，认识到信任是建立在持续的诚实之上的。

verse.textEn: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
verse.textZh: 人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不义，在大事上也不义。

title.en: High-profile Melbourne man called rapist and punched in face shortly after he raped former employee, court hears

body.en: The man, who cannot be named, faces two counts of rape and one count of sexual assault in Victoria’s county court. He has pleaded not guilty Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A high-profile Melbourne man was called a rapist and punched in the face by his former personal assistant shortly after he raped her at his home, a Victorian court has heard. But the man’s barrister, Dermot Dann KC, told the rape trial on Wednesday that the alleged victim had “massive issues” in relation to her credibility and reliability, including having previously made false allegations against police. body.zh: 该男子不愿透露姓名，他在维多利亚县法院面临两项强奸罪和一项性侵犯罪。维州一家法院获悉，一名备受瞩目的墨尔本男子在家中强奸了她后不久，他的前私人助理就被称为强奸犯，并用拳头打了她的脸。但该男子的律师德莫特·丹恩·KC (Dermot Dann KC) 在周三的强奸案审判中表示，这名受害者的可信度和可靠性存在“巨大问题”，包括此前曾对警方提出虚假指控。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of alleged sexual assault reminds us of the profound violation of a person's dignity and bodily integrity. Scripture teaches that our bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, sacred and not our own to be defiled or violated by others. This truth underscores the gravity of such acts and the deep need for justice and healing for those who suffer.
reflection.zh: 性侵指控的新闻提醒我们，一个人的尊严和身体的完整性受到了严重的侵犯。圣经教导我们，我们的身体是圣灵的殿，是神圣的，不属于我们自己，更不应被他人玷污或侵犯。这一真理强调了此类行为的严重性，以及受害者对公义和医治的深切需要。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own.
verse.textZh: 岂不知你们的身子就是圣灵的殿吗？这圣灵是从神而来，住在你们里面的。并且你们不是自己的人。

title.en: The European country preparing for a Russian attack, as Putin weighs odds
title.zh: 欧洲国家为俄罗斯袭击做准备，普京权衡利弊

summary.en: Poland is preparing for a potential Russian attack in the coming months, which officials describe as "critical." Experts suggest that provoking a war on two fronts would be detrimental for Russia.
summary.zh: 波兰正在为未来几个月可能发生的俄罗斯袭击做准备，官员们称这段时间“至关重要”。专家们表示，如果俄罗斯挑起两线作战，将面临惨重损失。

body.en:
For years, Poland has been preparing its citizens for war with Russia, turning metro stations into bomb shelters and teaching citizens survival skills. Now, the Polish government fears a Russian "provocation" is imminent.

"I don't mean to scare anyone, but the coming months may truly be critical," Poland's Prime Minister Donald Tusk told the media last week.

Tusk relayed a message he said came directly from United States intelligence: that Russia is preparing to attack Poland to test NATO.

Polish media reported the US warned Russia was planning a "provocation" in the coming months, which could be anything from a drone strike against critical infrastructure to a small-scale ground incursion on Polish territory.

Poland, along with its Baltic Sea allies Finland, Lithuania, and Estonia, blame growing Russian aggression for cyber attacks and drone incursions they say are testing their defences.

Now, as tensions between the US and Europe threaten to come to a head again at the NATO summit in Türkiye, questions remain about how far Russia would go to exploit Europe's weaknesses.

Meanwhile, Mick Ryan, senior fellow for military studies at the Lowy Institute, told SBS News the threat of Russian aggression should be taken "very seriously".

"It's become more apparent that Russia just can't win the [Ukraine] war , but equally, Putin cannot bring home a losing army," Ryan said.

"So somehow he has to manufacture a victory, either through Ukraine or something else."

The reported goal of Russian provocation would be to test NATO resolve and force Ukraine's allies to suspend aid, according to The Telegraph in the United Kingdom.

Article 5 of the NATO treaty requires member states, including the US, to come to the collective defence of another member if it is attacked.

According to The Telegraph, Polish security forces suspected Russia would potentially stage an accidental incursion, such as a GPS failure leading to an incursion on Polish territory, to provoke a NATO negotiation rather than an armed response.

They believed Russia would then use those talks to reduce Western support for Ukraine.

Bart Hogeveen, senior fellow at the Australian Strategic Policy Institute, told SBS News this is consistent with Russia's history.

"There are things in the Russian playbook they could use to just poke and provoke Poland, and by extension the European partners and NATO allies," he said.

"Poland is an important supporter of Ukraine, both in material terms as well as logistically ... so it's heavily directed at Poland, but it's there to undermine support to Ukraine."

title.en: The Telstra outage is a stark reminder of the widespread effects of single system failures
title.zh: Telstra网络中断，凸显单一系统故障的广泛影响

summary.en: A major network outage in Australia, affecting Telstra services, caused widespread disruption to essential infrastructure like trains, traffic lights, and payment systems. The incident has prompted concerns about the robustness and resilience of critical services.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚一次主要的网络中断影响了Telstra服务，导致火车、交通信号灯和电子支付系统等关键基础设施大范围瘫痪。此次事件引发了人们对关键服务韧性和可靠性的担忧。

body.en: The network disruption – which brought trains, traffic lights and Eftpos payments to a halt – raises questions about the resilience of services Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Wednesday’s national Telstra mobile outage serves as another stark reminder of how reliant on connectivity Australia now is, and how single points of failure can have widespread consequences across the country. The nearly five-hour outage – which brought train lines to a halt, affected traffic lights, stopped Eftpos payments and even prevented people being able to charge their electric vehicles – was caused by what Telstra’s chief financial officer, Michael Ackland, said was time-keeping servers that feed up-to-date information to the rest of the network. Continue reading...

title.en: US and Iran trade strikes after tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz
title.zh: 美国在霍尔木兹海峡油轮遇袭后对伊朗发动袭击

summary.en: The US Central Command announced it has launched strikes against Iran, stating the actions are intended to impose 'heavy costs' following incidents involving tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.
summary.zh: 美国中央司令部宣布已对伊朗发动袭击，称此举旨在对霍尔木兹海峡油轮遇袭事件后的伊朗施加“沉重代价”。

body.en:
US Central Command (Centcom) said on Tuesday it had launched "powerful" strikes in response to attacks on three oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, hitting more than 80 targets.

Iran has not directly claimed responsibility for the attacks on the tankers. On Wednesday, it said it had targeted US military sites in Bahrain and Kuwait in retaliation to the US attacks.

Nato chief Mark Rutte said the American strikes on Iran were "absolutely necessary", speaking as the military alliance began a summit in Ankara, Turkey.

"I think it was absolutely necessary," Rutte said, arguing that Iran was "basically violating the ceasefire" given what "happened yesterday with ships being attacked".

The US had said there would be consequences to what it has called the "wholly unacceptable" attacks on the three tankers.

title.en: Australia dock workers call for 28-hour week in AI talks
title.zh: 澳大利亚码头工人呼吁在人工智能谈判中实行每周28小时工作制

summary.en: A union representing Australian dock workers is advocating for a 28-hour work week, citing concerns that artificial intelligence is rapidly automating port operations and putting jobs at risk.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚码头工人所属工会呼吁实行每周28小时工作制，理由是人工智能正在港口作业中迅速实现自动化，工人们担心工作岗位面临风险。

body.en:
Australian dock workers are demanding a 28-hour work week with no loss of pay as the use of artificial intelligence (AI) and automation expands across the country's ports.

The AI push is being led by port logistics giant DP World, which the Maritime Union of Australia (MUA) said has put workers' jobs "in the crosshairs".

The union said: "If DP World wants AI and automation, then they must pay the social dividend. The new technology doesn't have to cost our members their jobs or put their livelihoods at risk just so a terminal operator can boost profits."

DP World, which is based in Dubai, is increasingly testing AI tools to manage employees and work schedules in its operations, according to a study by the Centre For International Corporate Tax Accountability and Research, which was commissioned by the MUA.

The automation programme is part of a pattern of pushing AI into operations "without genuine consultation" and that it threatens up to a thousand jobs or more than 60% of the dock and maintenance workforce, the study said.

The company has also proposed the use of AI-assisted remote-control cranes and driverless vehicles, it added.

The technology "should be used to improve workers' lives, not destroy them," the union said in a statement on 3 July as it called for a 28-hour work week.

DP World dock workers are believed to currently work around 32 to 35 hours a week, depending on their location, according to the Australian Financial Review, which first reported the negotiations.

The state-owned DP World is one of the world's largest port operators and is ultimately controlled by Dubai's ruler, Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum.

In Australia, it moves millions of shipping containers each year through its ports in Sydney, Melbourne and other parts of the country.

With operations in 84 countries and more than 126,000 employees around the world, the firm handles around a tenth of global container traffic.

Last year, DP World's Asia Pacific chief executive Glen Hilton said the company is using AI across ports in the region to manage increasingly complex supply chains.
body.zh: 随着人工智能 (AI) 和自动化在澳大利亚各港口的广泛应用，澳大利亚码头工人要求每周工作 28 小时且工资不得减少。 港口物流巨头迪拜环球港务集团 (DP World) 正在引领人工智能的发展，澳大利亚海事联盟 (MUA) 表示，该公司已将工人的工作置于“十字准线”。 该工会表示：“如果迪拜环球港务集团想要人工智能和自动化，那么他们必须支付社会红利。新技术不必让我们的会员失去工作或让他们的生计面临风险，这样码头运营商就可以提高利润。” 根据 MUA 委托的国际企业税务责任与研究中心的一项研究，总部位于迪拜的 DP World 正在越来越多地测试人工智能工具来管理其运营中的员工和工作安排。 研究称，自动化计划是“未经真正协商”将人工智能推向运营模式的一部分，它威胁到多达 1000 个工作岗位，即超过 60% 的码头和维护劳动力。 该公司还提议使用人工智能辅助遥控起重机和无人驾驶汽车。 工会在 7 月 3 日的一份声明中表示，这项技术“应该用来改善工人的生活，而不是摧毁他们”，并呼吁每周工作 28 小时。 据最先报道此次谈判的《澳大利亚金融评论报》报道，据信迪拜环球港务集团码头工人目前每周工作约 32 至 35 个小时，具体取决于他们所在的地点。 国有的迪拜环球港务集团是世界上最大的港口运营商之一，最终由迪拜统治者谢赫·穆罕默德·本·拉希德·阿勒马克图姆控制。 在澳大利亚，该公司每年通过悉尼、墨尔本和该国其他地区的港口运输数百万个集装箱。 该公司在全球 84 个国家/地区开展业务，拥有超过 126,000 名员工，处理全球约十分之一的集装箱运输量。 去年，迪拜环球港务集团亚太区首席执行官格伦·希尔顿表示，该公司正在该地区的各个港口使用人工智能来管理日益复杂的供应链。

reflection.en: As technology advances and reshapes the nature of work, it is vital to remember that every person is created in Yahweh's image, possessing inherent dignity and worth. Discussions about automation and work hours should prioritize human flourishing, ensuring that progress serves humanity rather than diminishing its value and purpose.
reflection.zh: 随着科技进步重塑工作性质，我们必须铭记每个人都是按雅伟的形象所造，拥有固有的尊严和价值。关于自动化和工时长的讨论，应以人类的繁荣为优先，确保科技进步是服务人类，而非贬低其价值和意义。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Nato allies announce £37bn for new missile project
title.zh: 北约盟友宣布370亿英镑新导弹项目

summary.en: Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer will convene around a dozen leaders to discuss the programme in Ankara.
summary.zh: 首相基尔·斯塔默爵士将在安卡拉召集约十二位领导人讨论该项目。

body.en:
Twelve countries, including the UK, are set to spend more than £37bn ($50bn) over the next 10 years on a new long-range missile to protect Europe.

The Deep Precision Strike project has just been unveiled by No 10 and is due to be discussed later on Wednesday at the Nato summit in the Turkish capital, Ankara.

Sir Keir Starmer is there for his final Nato summit as prime minister. He is likely to face some criticism from US President Donald Trump for failing to set out a plan for reaching 3.5% of GDP spent on defence by 2035, a target agreed by nearly all Nato members last year.

But on Wednesday the prime minister will convene around a dozen leaders to discuss the new missile programme.

Billed as one of Nato's most advanced weapons, it is intended to strike targets nearly 200 miles (300km) away with pinpoint accuracy, possibly extending out to 1,250 miles.

Sir Keir said the UK-led initiative would "help bring European allies together to keep Nato safe for years to come".

Foreign Secretary Yvette Cooper said the plan was "part of a recognition that we're in a more dangerous world".

"This is about how we make sure we have a stronger Europe within a stronger Nato," she told BBC Breakfast from Ankara.

But like many planned military projects in the pipeline, Deep Strike is not expected to be ready until the 2030s.

In June, US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth announced a six-month review of the presence of US forces in Europe.

Trump has repeatedly made clear he wants Nato members to contribute more to defence spending in Europe and at last year's Nato summit, members of the alliance agreed to spend 5% of GDP on defence and security by 2035.

Sir Keir said he was "determined" to ensure the safety of the UK and its allies, adding: "We must step up to deliver a stronger, more European Nato."

The UK government has already committed £300bn by 2030 in the Defence Investment Plan.

At the summit, Sir Keir is expected to underline the threat posed by Russia to the UK and Nato.

The government said Nato had scrambled fighter jets to intercept Russian aircraft approaching allied airspace more than 700 times and that Russian military activity around UK waters had surged 30%.

Sir Keir is expected to stress that whilst Nato did not seek confrontation with Russia, it must be ready to defend every ally.

Cooper said: "With deep precision strike capability, the UK and our allies will be able to hit high value military targets and the logistical engines that drive armies, deterring any aggressor and strengthening our mutual security.

"At Ankara we are sending a clear message to [Russian] President [Vladimir] Putin; Nato is stronger, more European and ready to defend our citizens against the long-term threat posed by him and the Russian state."

title.en: Russian fuel shortages bite – but will Putin change tack in Ukraine war?
title.zh: 俄罗斯燃料短缺加剧——但普京会在乌克兰战争中改变策略吗？

summary.en: Authorities in Moscow are struggling to ensure fuel supplies, leading to shortages. The situation raises questions about whether this economic pressure will prompt a shift towards peace talks or further escalation in the Ukraine war.
summary.zh: 莫斯科当局难以保障燃料供应，导致短缺。这种情况引发了人们的疑问：这种经济压力将促使乌克兰战争走向和谈还是进一步升级？

body.en:
If you want to get a sense of the fuel crisis gripping Russia, all you need to do is spend a day driving around Moscow. At almost every petrol station we passed there was a queue of cars and lorries. Some lines were long, some short; some static, others moving steadily.

If there was no queue, that meant the garage had run out of fuel entirely and was closed.

Remember: this is Moscow, the wealthy, populated capital that draws in so much of Russia's vast resources. Even here the authorities cannot ensure there is enough petrol and diesel to keep Muscovites on the road.

Yet, in the queues, the mood was more frustrated than angry. Yekaterina told us she was "not happy" and there was "panic because everybody thinks there will be no oil". But it would OK, she said, "we just need to reorganise the oil distribution".

The situation according to Elmar was "very bad" and he complained prices were going up as fuel stocks ran low. "You are wasting hours to fill up," he said. "At the moment I am planning a trip to Dagestan but I don't know if I should drive there or not because there are so many problems with petrol."

I asked him who was to blame. "In our country, you can't say what is to blame and who is to blame," he said, with a knowing smile.

In Russia, criticism of the president, or even the Kremlin, is not something most feel they can do in public.

Valery said it was strange having to queue in a country that extracts so much oil. He blamed the lack of Russian preparedness as much as Ukrainian missiles. "I have no desire to get used to queues," he said. "I hope the situation will change soon and won't be continued."

President Vladimir Putin has worked hard to insulate most people from the consequences of what he calls his special military operation, now well into its fifth year. On the streets of Moscow, one can see little sign of the war, just a few posters about heroic soldiers.

Yet what is harder for the authorities to ignore are the increasing number of Ukrainian drone and missile strikes deep into Russian territory, targeting oil refineries, darkening the skies over Moscow and St Petersburg.

Add to that internet shutdowns restricting the spread of information, and now the fuel shortages.

Russia, one of the world's biggest oil producers, is struggling to refine enough fuel to meet domestic demand.

Andrei was queuing for the first time, with his wife Yekaterina. He blamed what he called "geopolitics" and accepted the situation could get worse.

title.en: US strikes more than 80 Iranian targets after Hormuz attacks as tensions spike
title.zh: 霍尔木兹袭击后美国打击80多个伊朗目标，紧张局势升级

summary.en: The United States conducted strikes on over 80 Iranian targets following attacks in the Strait of Hormuz, leading to increased tensions. Iran responded by accusing the US of repeatedly violating a memorandum of understanding between the two nations.
summary.zh: 在霍尔木兹海峡发生袭击后，美国对80多个伊朗目标发动了打击，导致紧张局势加剧。伊朗指责美国一再违反两国之间达成的谅解备忘录。

body.en:
The United States military hit over 80 targets during its latest strikes on Iran, US Central Command (CENTCOM) said on Wednesday, conducted in response to Iran's attacks on three ships in the Strait of Hormuz.

"US forces struck Iranian defence systems, command and control networks, coastal radar sites, anti-ship missile capabilities, and more than 60 Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps small boats in and near the strait," the US military said in a statement posted to X.

CENTCOM said the "powerful" strikes were in response to Iranian attacks on ships transiting the vital waterway and would "impose heavy costs for targeting and attacking commercial shipping".

Following the strikes, Iran said it had carried out strikes on Bahrain in retaliation for US bombing of Iranian targets, with Tehran accusing Washington of violating their deal to end the war.

"In retaliation for the aggression of the American enemy ... and for the violation of the agreement ... army drones attacked the American enemy forces located at Sheikh Isa air base," Iran's military said in a statement.

Iranian media reported numerous explosions around the strait, including six on the island of Qeshm, seven in the city of Sirik and more in the major port city of Bandar Abbas.

Iran's foreign ministry accused the US of repeatedly violating the memorandum of understanding agreed between the two sides and threatened retaliation.

"Iran is issuing a serious warning about the consequences of America's breach of the treaty, and will take decisive measures to protect its interests and national security," the ministry said in a statement carried by official media.

The strikes came shortly after the US revoked a temporary sanctions waiver for Iranian oil, raising pressure on Iran as it negotiates with the US over a final settlement to the conflict.

The US treasury department cancelled a license announced in June that had allowed Iran to produce, sell and deliver crude oil and related products through 21 August.

"Iran's actions in the Strait were wholly unacceptable to the United States and will be met with consequences," a US official told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency.

The official, speaking on condition of anonymity, said the US-Iran memorandum of understanding was "entirely performance-based", warning that Iran would see benefits only if it showed "good behaviour".

But US negotiators were continuing to work "in good faith towards a final deal," the official said.

British maritime security agency UKMTO said an "unknown projectile" hit a tanker overnight, causing a fire, before two more vessels were struck, at least one by a drone.

title.en: Crowds bid farewell to Khamenei in Iranian holy city of Qom as body arrives in Iraq
title.zh: 人群在伊朗圣城库姆为哈梅内伊送行，遗体运抵伊拉克

summary.en: Public funeral ceremonies have begun for the late Iranian Supreme Leader, with crowds gathering to bid farewell as his body arrived in the holy city of Qom. The ceremonies are scheduled to last for six days.
summary.zh: 已故伊朗最高领袖的公开葬礼仪式于周六开始，人群聚集在圣城库姆为他送行，其遗体已运抵伊拉克。葬礼仪式将持续六天。

body.en:
The body of Iran's supreme leader Ali Khamenei arrived at Najaf international airport in Iraq on Wednesday morning, Iraqi state media reported, ahead of funeral processions in the country's holy cities which are home to the shrines most revered by Shia Muslims.

Iran began six days of public funeral ceremonies for Khamenei on Saturday, including a dedicated day to neighbouring Iraq — a Shia powerhouse with close ties to Iran.

Khamenei, killed on the first day of the Middle East war in US-Israeli strikes, will be buried on Thursday in his hometown of Mashhad in northeast Iran.

Iraqi state TV broadcast the arrival of the Mahan Air flight that brought Khamenei's coffin to Najaf airport, where Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian had arrived shortly before to attend the official Iraqi ceremony.

Iraqi officials and senior politicians, including Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi, were also there to receive the remains of the late supreme leader.

Iranian commander Esmail Qaani, who heads the foreign operations branch of Iran's Revolutionary Guards, known as the Quds Force, was also present.

At the airport, red carpets stretched across the terminal's floor, with large posters displaying Islamic calligraphy and a portrait of Khamenei.

The Iraqi government declared Wednesday a public holiday with processions set to begin at 6am AST (1pm AEST) in the holy city of Najaf.

In Najaf, mourners started arriving at least a day in advance for a six-kilometre procession that should culminate at the majestic shrine of Imam Ali — the Prophet Mohammed's son-in-law and the first Shia Imam.

The city's main streets have been draped with welcoming banners and large portraits of the late leader.

Mohammed al-Bayati, 30, who travelled for hours to Najaf, told the Agence France-Presse news agency "this is an opportunity that cannot be missed".

He added that he came to attend "the funeral of the figure who challenged the power of America and Israel".

After Najaf, Khamenei's body will be flown to Karbala, around 60 kilometres north, for another procession ending at the shrines of Imam Hussein and his brother Abbas.

Khamenei's remains will be taken to the shrine of Imam Ali, the first Shia Imam, in Najaf, one of the most prestigious centres of Shia scholarship in the world.

He will later be transported to the shrines of Imam Hussein, the third Shia Imam, and his brother Abbas in Karbala.

Hussein's death in the seventh century remains the central event in Shia history and tradition.

title.en: IOC lifts ban on Russian athletes, paving the way for 2028 Games return
title.zh: 国际奥委会解除对俄罗斯运动员的禁令，为2028年奥运会回归铺平道路

summary.en: The International Olympic Committee has lifted its ban on Russian athletes, potentially allowing their return for the 2028 Games, despite the ongoing war that initially led to the suspension of the Russian Olympic Committee.
summary.zh: 国际奥委会已解除对俄罗斯运动员的禁令，这可能为他们重返2028年奥运会铺平道路，尽管最初导致俄罗斯奥委会暂停资格的战争仍在继续。

body.en:
The International Olympic Committee (IOC) has provisionally lifted its suspension of the Russian Olympic ‌Committee (ROC), marking a significant step towards Russia's reintegration into the Olympic fold ahead of the Los Angeles 2028 Games.

Following Russia's invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, ‌the ROC was suspended in October 2023 for recognising regional Olympic councils in Russian-occupied parts of Ukraine — Luhansk, Donetsk, Kherson and Zaporizhzhia.

The IOC said its executive board had lifted that suspension but had not decided yet on whether Russia could display its flag, colours or have its anthem played at the Games.

"We don't condone any wars, including this one. We will continue to support Ukraine like we have since this started. But I don't ‌believe athletes should ‌pay the price," IOC President ⁠Kirsty Coventry told a press conference on Tuesday (local time).

"We don't want to hold athletes accountable for the actions of their government. We made it clear that all athletes had the possibility to compete at the Olympic Games.

"This is what this decision speaks to. It allows Russian athletes to take part in sports competitions. We thought it was really important for athletes to have that possibility," Coventry said.

In response, skeleton racer Vladyslav Heraskevych, the Ukrainian face of the Milano Cortina Games after being banned for wearing a helmet featuring athletes killed in the war, called for a coalition of national Olympic committees to oppose the decision and said visa bans and boycott talks should be on the table.

Ukraine's Foreign Ministry said the decision was "a troubling ⁠signal for ‌the entire international community", and urged countries hosting competitions to uphold a ban on Russian state symbols as "under this flag an unprovoked ‌war is continuing in Ukraine".

Russian sports minister Mikhail Degtyarev said the IOC's decision should clear the way for Russian athletes to make a full ⁠return to the international sporting stage.

"Our country's return to the Olympic family is a ‌green light for international federations to reinstate all our athletes," Degtyarev said.

Russian athletes competed as neutrals at the 2024 Paris Olympics and at the 2026 Milano Cortina Winter Games.

title.en: UK populist leader Nigel Farage steps down as an MP
title.zh: 英国民粹主义领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇辞去国会议员职务

summary.en: Nigel Farage, leader of the Reform party, has resigned as a Member of Parliament, triggering a by-election in his constituency. He has announced his intention to contest the seat in the upcoming election.
summary.zh: 改革党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇已辞去国会议员职务，从而引发了他所在选区的补选。他已宣布将参加这次补选。

body.en:
British anti-immigrant politician Nigel Farage has announced he will resign as a member of parliament to run in a snap by-election, in a high-stakes gamble following intense scrutiny over his finances.

The unusual move comes as Farage, whose Reform UK party leads national opinion polls, faces mounting pressure over the non-disclosure of gifts, including allegedly from a convicted fraudster.

"I've decided that the people of Clacton should be the judges of my actions," Farage said in a televised address, referring to the southeast England constituency he has represented for two years.

"This will be a people versus the establishment by-election," he added, confirming he would be putting his name forward to stand.

Parliament's anti-corruption watchdog has been investigating the hard-right firebrand and long-time anti-European Union campaigner over the non-disclosure of a £5 million ($9.6 million) donation from Thailand-based cryptocurrency billionaire Christopher Harborne.

Farage's resignation means the probe will be suspended until after the by-election.

But Labour and the Conservative parties have both said they will not field candidates in a by-election, UK media reported.

"Nigel Farage is engulfed in a sleaze scandal, and he's desperately trying to change the subject," a Labour spokesperson said.

Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch said her party would only field a "candidate in the real by-election, which will follow the standards investigation into Nigel Farage's fishy finances".

Daniel Greenberg, the parliamentary commissioner for standards, is also facing calls to investigate allegations that George Cottrell, convicted of wire fraud in the United States, paid for security and staff for Farage shortly before he became a member of parliament.

Farage, who helped persuade Britons to vote to leave the EU during a divisive referendum in 2016, was elected an MP on his eighth attempt during the July 2024 general election.

Reform, which advocates mass deportations of illegal migrants and the scrapping of net zero energy targets, has since led the ruling Labour party in opinion polls.

Fears among Labour MPs that Reform could win the next nationwide vote, expected in 2029, ultimately led them to force UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer to announce his resignation last month .

New MPs are supposed to register any money they received in the 12 months before their election unless it cannot be "reasonably" seen as linked to political activities.

Farage has insisted he did not need to declare the money from Harborne because it was a personal gift to pay for his own security.

title.en: Attacks on Kyiv ahead of NATO summit: What is Putin's goal?
title.zh: 北约峰会前夕基辅遭袭：普京的目标是什么？

summary.en: Kyiv experienced significant Russian missile attacks just before the NATO summit in Ankara. Analysts suggest these strikes were intended by Russian President Vladimir Putin to convey a political message.
summary.zh: 在北约安卡拉峰会前夕，基辅遭受了俄罗斯的猛烈袭击。专家表示，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京此举旨在传递一个信息。

body.en:
Kyiv suffered heavy Russian strikes ahead of the NATO summit in Ankara. Experts say Russian President Vladimir Putin is trying to send a message.

Ukraine is slowly recovering after yet another heavy Russian bombardment. Overnight on Monday, Russia launched a massive attack on the Ukrainian capital. 

At least 22 people were killed and dozens injured in Kyiv after residential buildings and infrastructure were struck. In the Kyiv region, the main target, 15 people died. Debris is being cleared at more than 20 sites.

On the evening of July 5, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned citizens that intelligence reports indicated Russia was preparing a large attack. "This reflects Putin's mindset — immediately after the US Independence Day and ahead of the NATO summit in Ankara . Russia wants to cause even more harm and kill people," Zelenskyy said in a video message on the messaging platform Telegram.

The president urged Ukrainians to heed air raid warnings. He also called on Ukraine's partners to speed up deliveries of interceptor missiles for  Patriot systems .

His warning proved accurate. According to Ukraine authorities, Russia launched 68 missiles of various types overnight, including Iskander-M ballistic missiles, 3M22 Zircon and Oniks cruise missiles as well as 351 drones. Although Ukrainian air defenses managed to intercept a high percentage of cruise missiles on July 6, they were unable to shoot down a single ballistic missile.

Yurii Ihnat, spokesperson for Ukraine's Air Force, said the main reason was a shortage of Patriot missiles.

"Ballistic attacks are once again hitting civilians. Because the enemy cannot achieve its goals on the battlefield, it is increasingly directing ballistic missiles at residential buildings and killing civilians," Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov said. 

Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha described the latest bombardment as "one of the most brutal attacks ever, involving dozens of ballistic missiles." He called on NATO heads of government to be aware of what the people of Kyiv had to endure. "Protect Ukrainian children from Russian ballistic terror. There is no more urgent task," Sybiha wrote on the social network X.

With the latest strike on Ukraine coming ahead of the NATO summit in Ankara, Vladimir Putin wants to signal to the alliance that none of its decisions to support Ukraine can deter it, says Oleksandr Kraiev, an analyst at the Kyiv-based Ukrainian Prism foreign policy think tank. "He wants to intimidate Europeans and NATO allies so that at some point they view their support for Ukraine as pointless, with the message: 'No matter what you do, Putin will attack anyway'," Kraiev told DW

title.en: How drones transformed Iran's Axis of Resistance militias in Lebanon, Gaza, Yemen and Iraq

summary.en: The proliferation of drone technology, including production, transfer, and training, has significantly enhanced the operational independence of Iran's allied militias across Lebanon, Gaza, Yemen, and Iraq. This development raises questions about the long-term resilience of these networks against conventional military...
summary.zh: 无人机技术（包括生产、转让和培训）的扩散，显著增强了伊朗在黎巴嫩、加沙、也门和伊拉克盟友民兵的行动独立性。这一发展引发了人们对这些网络通过常规军事打击是否已变得过于强大而难以瓦解的疑问。

body.en:
Drone production, technology transfer and training have enabled Iran's regional allies to operate with far greater independence. Has this network become too resilient to be dismantled through military strikes?

When the United States and Israel launched the war on Iran in late February, they hoped to cripple both the Islamic Republic and its so-called "Axis of Resistance" in the Middle East. This comprises Iran's paramilitary proxy groups, including Hamas in Gaza, Hezbollah in Lebanon, the Houthis in Yemen and militias in Iraq, all of whom are opposed to the US and Israel.

The assumption was that "by hitting the right leaders, weapons facilities and supply lines, an outside actor could induce catastrophic failure across the Iranian regime and its web of Middle Eastern allies," said Peter Salisbury, a fellow at US think tank Century International and lead author of the think tank's recently published report "Beyond the Axis."

Despite the US and Israel achieving many of those military objectives, Iranian forces were able to continue launching drone attacks on neighboring Gulf states and shipping in the Strait of Hormuz , while their allies in Lebanon and Yemen intensified attacks against Israel and commercial shipping in the Red Sea.

For Wolf-Christian Paes, associate fellow at the International Institute for Strategic Studies, and one of the contributors to the "Beyond the Axis" report, the term "proxies" is actually misleading as it implies a command-and-control relationship between Tehran  and the members of the axis.

"Unmanned aerial vehicle [UAV] proliferation is a good example," he told DW. A few years ago, Tehran transferred complete systems and the necessary training to its allies. "Today these militias can build their own UAVs, based on Iranian designs, with most of the parts coming from countries other than Iran," Paes said.

For example, according to the report, which was published after two years of research, these groups are able to source large quantities of engines for the Shahed-136 drone directly from Chinese manufacturers. 

"Dual-use technology is difficult to control in the first place and without a traditional hub for smuggling, tracking the supply chain is like looking for a needle in a haystack," Paes told DW, adding that for example China , Russia  but also Oman  have so far made no real attempts to control the movement of these items.

According to the "Beyond the Axis" report, drone-related conflict incidents around the world rose from 140 in 2016 to more than 58,000 in 2025, a 41,000% increase.

body.zh: 无人机生产、技术转让和培训使伊朗的地区盟友能够以更大的独立性开展行动。这个网络是否已经变得太有弹性而无法通过军事打击来摧毁？ 当美国和以色列二月底对伊朗发动战争时，他们希望削弱这个伊斯兰共和国及其在中东的所谓“抵抗轴心”。这包括伊朗的准军事代理人组织，包括加沙的哈马斯、黎巴嫩的真主党、也门的胡塞武装和伊拉克的民兵组织，所有这些组织都反对美国和以色列。 美国智库世纪国际研究员、该智库最近发表的报告《超越轴心国》的主要作者彼得·索尔兹伯里表示，人们的假设是，“外部行为者通过打击正确的领导人、武器设施和供应线，可能会导致整个伊朗政权及其中东盟友网络的灾难性失败”。 尽管美国和以色列实现了其中许多军事目标，但伊朗军队仍能够继续对邻近的海湾国家和霍尔木兹海峡的航运发动无人机攻击，而其在黎巴嫩和也门的盟友则加强了对以色列和红海商业航运的攻击。 对于国际战略研究所副研究员、《超越轴心国》报告的撰稿人之一沃尔夫-克里斯蒂安·佩斯来说，“代理人”一词实际上具有误导性，因为它暗示了德黑兰与轴心国成员之间的指挥与控制关系。 “无人机的扩散就是一个很好的例子，”他告诉德国之声。几年前，德黑兰向其盟友转让了完整的系统和必要的培训。佩斯说：“如今，这些民兵可以根据伊朗的设计制造自己的无人机，其中大部分零部件来自伊朗以外的国家。” 例如，根据这份经过两年研究后发布的报告，这些组织能够直接从中国制造商那里采购大量 Shahed-136 无人机的发动机。 佩斯告诉德国之声：“军民两用技术一开始就很难控制，如果没有传统的走私中心，追踪供应链就像大海捞针一样。”他补充说，中国、俄罗斯以及阿曼等国迄今为止尚未真正尝试控制这些物品的流动。 根据《超越轴心》报告，全球与无人机相关的冲突事件从 2016 年的 140 起增加到 2025 年的 58,000 多起，增加了 41,000%。 “伊朗合作伙伴独立制造和部署无人机的能力不断增强，这也正在改变他们与德黑兰关系的性质，”尼尔·奎利姆（Neil Quillam）说。

reflection.en: The increasing sophistication and spread of drone technology highlight the persistent human challenge of conflict and the evolving nature of warfare. Yet, Psalm 46:9 reminds us that Yahweh ultimately brings an end to wars, breaking the instruments of battle, no matter how advanced they become. This offers a profound hope that even the most resilient...
reflection.zh: 无人机技术的日益复杂和扩散，凸显了人类冲突的持续挑战和战争不断演变的性质。然而，诗篇46:9提醒我们，雅伟最终会止息战争，折断一切争战的器械，无论它们变得多么先进。这带来了一个深刻的盼望，即便是最顽固的冲突网络，也无法超越神圣的力量。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: Conflict, climate change, cash-strapped: Why poverty persists
title.zh: 冲突、气候变化、资金短缺：贫困为何持续存在

summary.en: A new report indicates that global efforts to achieve the UN's Sustainable Development Goals are being hindered by persistent challenges such as ongoing conflicts, the impacts of climate change, and insufficient funding, with less than five years remaining to meet the targets.
summary.zh: 一份新报告指出，在全球实现联合国可持续发展目标的剩余不到五年时间里，持续的冲突、气候变化的影响以及资金不足等挑战，正在阻碍进展。

body.zh: 距离完成联合国可持续发展目标还有不到五年的时间，一份新报告揭示了阻碍进展的因素。以及解决方案是什么。 十分之一的人仍处于极端贫困之中，超过 20 亿人面临中度或严重的粮食不安全，自 2015 年以来，受气候相关灾害影响的人数增加了一倍多。这是根据联合国今天发布的一份报告中的数据得出的。 十多年前，国际社会同意消除一切形式的贫困、消除不平等和应对气候变化。联合国制定了到2030年要实现的17个目标和169个具体目标，例如零饥饿、清洁水和卫生设施、良好的健康和福祉以及获得负担得起的清洁能源。 尽管某些领域取得了进展，包括近 10 亿人获得了安全管理的饮用水、新发艾滋病毒感染人数和与艾滋病相关的死亡人数下降以及全球 92% 的人口通电，但许多其他领域仍远远偏离正轨。 近一半的目标进展速度过慢，15% 的目标已低于 2015 年基线。 预计到 2026 年，全球极端贫困率将达到 10%，仅比 2015 年水平低 3 个百分点。大约四分之一的城市居民居住在贫民窟或非正规住区。此外，所有物种群体的灭绝风险都在加剧，2025 年全球气温将比工业化前水平高出 1.43 摄氏度（2.57 华氏度）。地球大气中的二氧化碳浓度达到 200 万年来的最高水平。 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯敦促各国加大力度，因为 2025 年官方发展援助将大幅下降 23%，创历史新高。 他说：“让我们共同为实现可持续发展目标并为所有人建设一个健康、繁荣的未来做出决定性的最后推动。” 暴力冲突激增阻碍了进展，几个月内就毁掉了多年的发展。 尽管发展中国家可持续发展目标的年度融资缺口约为 4 万亿美元（3.5 万亿欧元），但全球军费开支却创下历史新高。 中东战争扰乱了海上交通，阻断了能源、化肥和食品走廊。这可能会给全球粮食安全带来严重的长期后果，特别是在非洲和亚洲部分地区。 尽管2024年全球饥饿人数略有减少，但仍高于2015年。世界上超过8%的人口长期处于饥饿状态，超过20亿人在一年中的某个时候无法获得足够的食物。 进展主要归功于南亚和拉丁美洲疫情后的经济复苏。西方国家的饥饿人数持续上升...

reflection.en: The persistent challenges of poverty, exacerbated by conflict and climate change, remind us of the deep human need for liberation and hope. Yahweh's Spirit empowers us to bring good news to the poor and work towards setting the oppressed free, addressing both immediate suffering and systemic injustices.
reflection.zh: 冲突和气候变化加剧的持续贫困挑战，提醒我们人类对自由和希望的深切需求。雅伟的灵赋予我们能力，将好消息带给贫困者，并努力使受压迫者得自由，从而解决眼前的苦难和系统性的不公。

verse.textEn: The Spirit of Yahweh is on me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor.
verse.textZh: 主的灵在我身上，因为他用膏膏我，叫我传福音给贫穷的人。

title.en: Ghana: Uncertainty hangs over new government anti-corruption plan
title.zh: 加纳：新政府反腐计划前景未明

summary.en: President John Dramani Mahama of Ghana has introduced an anti-corruption plan aimed at strengthening public accountability and building trust. Governance experts, however, emphasize that the plan's success hinges on the consistent enforcement of existing laws.
summary.zh: 加纳总统约翰·德拉马尼·马哈马提出了一项反腐计划，旨在加强公共问责制并建立信任。然而，治理专家强调，该计划的成功将取决于现有法律的持续执行。

body.en:
President John Dramani Mahama wants to build trust by strengthening public accountability. But governance experts say the success of the anti-corruption plan will depend on the consistent enforcement of existing laws.

Ghana has launched its new National Ethics and Anti-Corruption Action Plan (NEACAP), with President John Dramani Mahama pledging to strengthen accountability, ethical leadership and public participation in government institutions in the fight against corruption.

Unveiling the five-year strategy at the University of Ghana in Accra last week, Mahama described corruption in the country as "a national development challenge" that weakens institutions, discourages investment and erodes public trust.

The leader called for collective effort involving government, civil society, the private sector and citizens, saying the fight against corruption requires the participation of all Ghanaians.

Often regarded as one of West Africa's most stable democracies, Ghana has enjoyed decades of relatively   peaceful elections and democratic transfers of power .

Yet corruption continues to undermine public confidence across the nation, weakening public service delivery and discouraging investment.

The new action plan seeks to change this by improving coordination among anti-corruption institutions, strengthening oversight, promoting ethical leadership across the public sector and increasing citizen participation in accountability efforts.

It will replace Ghana's previous National Anti-Corruption Action Plan, which had widely been criticized for falling short of its objectives as its implementation remained inconsistent despite an extensive legal and institutional framework.

The launch comes as Ghana continues to make only modest progress in international corruption rankings.

According to the 2025 Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI) by Transparency International , Ghana scored 43 out of 100, ranking 76th globally while remaining above the sub-Saharan African regional average.

The country continues to trail behind African leaders such as the Seychelles, Cabo Verde and Botswana.

Transparency International Ghana says the country's performance has stagnated because of weak enforcement of anti-corruption laws, political interference and insufficient institutional reforms.

Analysts like Mary Awelana Addah, executive director of Transparency International Ghana, agree the country's problems are not based on a lack of anti-corruption institutions but rather on ensuring that these mechanisms are able to operate independently and effectively.

"The corruption problem in Ghana is a very large one. It's been very costly to the state. It is endemic and systemic in nature," Addah told DW.

She explained that corruption had resulted in a deficit of...
body.zh: 约翰·德拉马尼·马哈马总统希望通过加强公共责任来建立信任。但治理专家表示，反腐败计划的成功将取决于现行法律的持续执行。 加纳启动了新的国家道德和反腐败行动计划（NEACAP），总统约翰·德拉马尼·马哈马承诺加强政府机构的问责制、道德领导力和公众参与，打击腐败。 马哈马上周在阿克拉加纳大学公布了五年战略，他将该国的腐败描述为“国家发展挑战”，它削弱了机构、阻碍了投资并侵蚀了公众信任。 这位领导人呼吁政府、民间社会、私营部门和公民共同努力，并表示反腐败斗争需要所有加纳人的参与。 加纳通常被认为是西非最稳定的民主国家之一，几十年来一直享有相对和平的选举和民主的权力转移。 然而，腐败继续损害全国公众的信心，削弱公共服务的提供并阻碍投资。 新的行动计划旨在通过改善反腐败机构之间的协调、加强监督、促进整个公共部门的道德领导力以及增加公民参与问责工作来改变这一状况。 它将取代加纳之前的国家反腐败行动计划，该计划因未达到其目标而受到广泛批评，因为尽管有广泛的法律和体制框架，但其实施仍然不一致。 根据透明国际2025年清廉指数（CPI），加纳得分为43分（满分100分），在全球排名第76位，仍高于撒哈拉以南非洲地区平均水平。 该国继续落后于塞舌尔、佛得角和博茨瓦纳等非洲领导人。 透明国际加纳表示，由于反腐败法执行不力、政治干预和机构改革不足，该国的表现停滞不前。 透明国际加纳执行董事玛丽·阿韦拉纳·阿达（Mary Awelana Addah）等分析人士认为，该国的问题并非源于缺乏反腐败机构，而是在于确保这些机制能够独立有效地运作。 阿达告诉德国之声：“加纳的腐败问题非常严重。国家为此付出了高昂的代价。它是地方性的、系统性的。” 她解释说，审计长 2024 年报告中指出，腐败导致了近 150 亿欧元的财务违规赤字……

reflection.en: A government's commitment to justice and accountability is vital for building public trust and fostering a healthy society. As Ghana embarks on its anti-corruption plan, the call to "do justice" reminds leaders that true governance requires consistent, ethical action. Yahweh desires that those in authority act with integrity, ensuring laws are applied...
reflection.zh: 政府对正义和问责的承诺对于建立公众信任和促进健康社会至关重要。当加纳启动其反腐计划时，“行公义”的呼召提醒领导者，真正的治理需要持续、合乎道德的行动。雅伟渴望掌权者以正直行事，确保法律得到公正执行，以造福所有公民。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: 'The water just came so fast': Typhoon triggers floods and rare tornadoes in China
title.zh: “水来得太快了”：台风在中国引发洪水和罕见龙卷风

summary.en: Villagers whose families have been stranded told the BBC they are struggling to get food and help after a typhoon triggered floods and rare tornadoes in China.
summary.zh: 台风在中国引发洪水和罕见龙卷风后，受困村民告诉英国广播公司，他们的家人被困，正在努力获取食物和帮助。

body.en:
On Sunday, heavy rain began falling on Renhe village in the southern Chinese province of Guangxi.

The villagers were used to it. But the rain didn't stop - and the water suddenly rose.

By the early hours of Monday, the water had reached their knees. By dawn, it had completely submerged the first floor of their homes.

"The floods happened so rapidly, the water just came so fast. The villagers didn't have time to take food with them when they were running away," a woman from Renhe, whose surname is Zhou, told the BBC.

Zhou's family is among tens of thousands of people in Guangxi displaced from their homes since Typhoon Maysak swept the region over the weekend, causing rivers to swell and dam walls to break. At least four people have died.

The typhoon has inundated the city of Nanning and surrounding villages, with residents calling for rescue from their rooftops.

It has also triggered thunderstorms, and even tornadoes, in the central province of Hubei - hundreds of kilometres away.

At least 17 people have died, hundreds more have been injured and tens of thousands have been evacuated, according to state media.

The devastation from days of extreme weather has prompted President Xi Jinping to order "all out" rescue and relief operations.

Typhoons that cause widespread flooding are common in China at this time of the year and Maysak is the first to make landfall in the country for the 2026 season.

State media said it has been characterised by "its sudden onset and intense, short-duration winds".

Another storm, Super Typhoon Bavi, is churning across the Pacific, on course to hit China's eastern coast later this week, according to forecasts.

Authorities in Nanning have warned that "extremely heavy rain" could hamper rescue efforts.

Extreme weather, which experts link to climate change, have increasingly threatened China's residents and economy - especially its trillion-dollar agriculture sector.

Residents from Guangxi province have told the BBC that thousands remain trapped on rooftops, some in mountain villages, because of the floods.

The official count estimates 60,000 people have been evacuated and at least 90,000 in total are affected by the deluge.

Zhou, who is currently living in another province, said some of her family members are still trapped in their homes in Renhe and have limited food. Her four-month-old niece has gone for more than a day without milk.

"Other villagers are gathering at higher ground, but they are running out of supplies as well. There are too many villages affected, and not enough rescue workers."

Another woman, whose surname is Huang, from the town of Yunbiao said it took just 10 minutes for floods to submerge villages in her area.

body.zh: 周日，中国南部广西省人和村开始下大雨。 村民们已经习惯了。但雨并没有停——水位突然上涨。 到周一凌晨，水位已经达到了膝盖。到黎明时分，洪水已经完全淹没了他们家的一楼。 “洪水来得如此之快，水来得如此之快。村民们在逃跑时没有时间携带食物，”仁和一位周姓女士告诉BBC。 周末台风美莎克横扫广西，导致河流水位上涨、水坝溃决，周的家人是广西数万名流离失所者中的一员。至少有四人死亡。 台风已经淹没了南宁市和周边村庄，居民在屋顶上呼吁救援。 它还在数百公里外的中部省份湖北引发了雷暴，甚至龙卷风。 据官方媒体报道，至少 17 人死亡，数百人受伤，数万人被疏散。 连日来的极端天气造成的破坏促使习近平主席下令“全力以赴”开展救援行动。 每年这个时候，造成大范围洪水的台风在中国很常见，而“美莎克”是 2026 年第一个在中国登陆的台风。 官方媒体称，此次飓风的特点是“突然来袭、强风、持续时间短”。 据预测，另一场风暴超级台风巴威正在太平洋上肆虐，本周晚些时候将袭击中国东部沿海。 南宁当局警告称，“特大暴雨”可能会阻碍救援工作。 专家将极端天气与气候变化联系起来，它日益威胁着中国的居民和经济，尤其是价值数万亿美元的农业部门。 广西省的居民告诉英国广播公司，由于洪水，数千人仍被困在屋顶上，其中一些人被困在山村里。 官方统计估计已有 60,000 人被疏散，总共至少有 90,000 人受到洪水影响。 目前居住在另一个省份的周说，她的一些家人仍然被困在仁和的家中，食物有限。她四个月大的侄女已经一天多没有喝奶了。 “其他村民正在地势较高的地方聚集，但他们的物资也即将耗尽。受影响的村庄太多，救援人员却不够。” 另一名来自云标镇的黄姓妇女表示，洪水只用了10分钟就淹没了她所在地区的村庄。 “我们根本无法及时营救所有人。营救的人太少了......

reflection.en: The plight of villagers struggling for food and help after a typhoon reminds us of the profound human need for practical compassion in times of crisis. Yahweh's call in Isaiah 58:7 urges us to share our resources with the hungry and provide shelter for the displaced. In such moments, our care for those most vulnerable reflects a deeper commitment to justice...
reflection.zh: 台风过后，村民们为食物和援助而挣扎的困境，提醒我们在危机时刻，人类对实际关怀的深切需求。雅伟在以赛亚书58:7中的呼召，敦促我们与饥饿者分享食物，为流离失所者提供住所。在这样的时刻，我们对最脆弱者的关怀反映了对公义和怜悯的更深承诺。

verse.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter — when you see the naked, to clothe them?
verse.textZh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体？

title.en: Plenty of players but no grassroots: can China ever grow into a footballing giant?
title.zh: 球员众多但缺乏基层：中国能否成长为足球巨头？

summary.en: Experts note that despite large crowds at amateur matches, China lacks a robust grassroots system to develop players into professionals, hindering its ambition to become a footballing giant.
summary.zh: 专家指出，尽管中国业余足球比赛吸引了大量观众，但缺乏健全的基层体系将球员培养成职业选手，这阻碍了其成为足球强国的雄心。

body.en: Some of its amateur matches pull in bigger crowds than European leagues but are more of a spectacle than a pathway to the professional game, say experts Michael Owen, a man who once quipped he had never drunk tea or coffee, isn’t known for his adventurous palate. Safe to assume, then, that the former England striker was out of his comfort zone sipping Roxburgh rose juice and eating chilli-wrapped rice noodle rolls during his recent visit to south-west China’s Guizhou province. The 2001 Ballon d’Or winner dusted off his boots for a match in Rongjiang county, the birthplace of viral amateur football league Cun Chao, also known as the Village Super League. Scoring twice in a 4-3 loss for local side Rongjiang Niubi, Owen endeared himself to the thousands in attendance, even if some weren’t familiar with the former Liverpool and Real Madrid player. title.en: China's missile test builds on Pacific nuclear deterrence
title.zh: 中国导弹试验增强太平洋核威慑

summary.en: US allies in the Pacific have condemned China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile test, which Beijing described as routine. The test is seen as a demonstration of China's increasing military capabilities.
summary.zh: 太平洋地区的美国盟友谴责了中国最近进行的洲际弹道导弹试验，北京称之为“例行”测试。此次试验被视为中国展示其日益增长的军事能力。

body.en:
US allies in the Pacific condemned what Beijing has called a "routine" intercontinental ballistic missile test, which comes as China seeks to demonstrate its growing military capabilities.

On Monday, the Chinese Navy conducted a missile test in the South Pacific , with state media reporting that a nuclear submarine fired a missile carrying a dummy warhead into international waters.

The test quickly drew harsh criticism from US allies in the Pacific. Australia's Foreign Minister Penny Wong said the Chinese test was destabilizing for regional security. Japan called on China to reconsider its actions.

New Zealand said it does not want China to use the South Pacific as a testing ground for missiles. "We are deeply concerned about China's tests of nuclear-capable weapons in the South Pacific," Foreign Minister Winston Peters said in Wellington

During the Cold War, the US tested numerous nuclear weapons around the South Pacific's Bikini Atoll, which today is part of the Marshall Islands. Since World War II, the US has dominated the postwar security architecture in the Pacific region .

China's military buildup is now challenging this construct . Although official media have not released any details about the test, nationalist military experts are speculating on Chinese social media about how powerful the tested missile might have been.

"It is a submarine-launched intercontinental ballistic missile of the Julang (JL)-3 series," wrote Lieutenant Colonel Zhang Junshe a researcher with the People's Liberation Army (PLA) Naval Military Academic Research Institute.

The Julang-3, which means "Giant Wave-3" in English, is currently still under development.

It is said to have a maximum range of 12,000 kilometers (7,400 miles) and can carry multiple nuclear warheads. So far, three successful tests have been reported between 2018 and 2019.

"The target of this missile is not combat troops on the front lines, but strategic targets such as command centers, military bases, or energy infrastructure," Zhang wrote in his blog.

The "Giant Wave-3" is believed to have been launched from a Type 094 Jin-class nuclear-powered submarine. With a full crew of 120 sailors, the 135-meter-long submarine can sustain a submerged crew for at least 70 days. Currently, the Chinese Navy has six Type 094 submarines in service.

According to the Nuclear Threat Initiative, a Washington-based think tank, China operates an additional 59 nuclear-powered attack submarines in addition to the Jin-class submarines.

"Even if all other military weapons were to be put out of action, the Chinese submarine would still be fully capable of launching a nuclear counterstrike," Zhang wrote.

As early as September 2024, China had launched an intercontinental missile carrying a dummy warhead from the...
body.zh: 美国在太平洋的盟友谴责北京所谓的“例行”洲际弹道导弹试验，此次试验是在中国寻求展示其不断增长的军事能力之际进行的。 周一，中国海军在南太平洋进行了一次导弹试验，官方媒体报道称，一艘核潜艇向国际水域发射了一枚携带假弹头的导弹。 这次试验很快引起了美国太平洋盟友的严厉批评。澳大利亚外交部长黄英贤表示，中国的试验破坏了地区安全的稳定。日本呼吁中国重新考虑其行动。 新西兰表示不希望中国利用南太平洋作为导弹试验场。外交部长温斯顿·彼得斯在惠灵顿表示：“我们对中国在南太平洋进行核武器试验深感担忧” 冷战期间，美国在南太平洋比基尼环礁（今天是马绍尔群岛的一部分）周围测试了许多核武器。二战以来，美国一直主导着太平洋地区的战后安全架构。 中国的军力建设现在正在挑战这种结构。尽管官方媒体尚未公布有关此次测试的任何细节，但民族主义军事专家正在中国社交媒体上猜测测试的导弹的威力可能有多大。 中国人民解放军海军军事学术研究院研究员张军社中校写道：“这是巨狼（JL）-3系列潜射洲际弹道导弹。” Julang-3，英文意思是“Giant Wave-3”，目前仍在开发中。 据称其最大射程为12,000公里（7,400英里），可携带多枚核弹头。到目前为止，2018 年至 2019 年间已报告了三项成功的测试。 张在博客中写道：“这种导弹的目标不是前线的作战部队，而是指挥中心、军事基地或能源基础设施等战略目标。” 据信“巨浪3”是从一艘094型晋级核动力潜艇上发射的。这艘135米长的潜艇共有120名水手，可以让水下船员至少生存70天。目前，中国海军有6艘094型潜艇在役。 据华盛顿智库核威胁倡议组织称，除了晋级潜艇之外，中国还拥有59艘核动力攻击潜艇。 张写道：“即使所有其他军事武器都无法发挥作用，中国潜艇仍然完全有能力发动核反击。” 早在2024年9月，中国就从...发射了一枚携带假弹头的洲际导弹。

reflection.en: The news of missile tests highlights the ongoing global pursuit of security through military strength. Yet, the prophet Isaiah envisioned a future where nations would transform instruments of war into tools for peace, no longer training for conflict. This vision reminds us to pray for leaders to seek true security not in escalating arms, but in pathways of...
reflection.zh: 导弹试验的消息凸显了全球通过军事力量寻求安全的持续努力。然而，先知以赛亚曾预见一个未来，各国将把战争工具变为和平工具，不再为冲突而训练。这一愿景提醒我们为领袖祷告，愿他们不在军备竞赛中寻求真正的安全，而是在相互理解和裁军的道路上。

title.en: Japan, China coast guards square off near disputed islands
title.zh: 日本和中国海警在争议岛屿附近对峙

summary.en: Japanese and Chinese coast guard vessels confronted each other near the disputed Senkaku island chain, with both sides claiming they expelled the other. The incident comes amid rising tensions between Tokyo and Beijing.
summary.zh: 日本和中国海警船在有争议的尖阁列岛（中国称钓鱼岛）附近相互对峙，双方都声称驱逐了对方。此次事件发生在中日两国关系日益紧张之际。

body.en:
Japanese and Chinese coast guard vessels confronted each other near the disputed Senkaku island chain, with both sides claiming they expelled the other. The incident comes amid rising tensions between Tokyo and Beijing.

Japanese and Chinese coast guard vessels traded accusations on Tuesday after an encounter near the disputed Senkaku islands — also known as the Diaoyu islands in China — in the East China Sea.

Japan's coast guard said four Chinese vessels were operating near the islands, two of which entered what Tokyo considers its territorial waters.

The Chinese ships were approaching a Japanese fishing vessel in the area, according to Japan's coast guard.

The Japanese coast guard said it then "issued orders to leave ... successfully forcing the Chinese coast guard vessels to leave Japanese territorial waters by approximately 9:20 am (0020 GMT) today."

Tokyo described the Chinese vessels' actions as "a violation of international law."

In a separate statement, China's coast guard said that a Japanese fishing boat had "intruded into" its territorial waters and that its ships had taken "necessary measures to warn and expel it."

The statement said that the disputed island chain was "China's inherent territory," and that the Chinese coast guard urged the "Japanese side to immediately stop all rights-violation and provocative acts in relevant waters."

The uninhabited Senkaku island chain is administered by Japan but claimed by China.

Located between Taiwan and Japan's Okinawa island chain, the islands have long been a source of friction between Beijing and Tokyo. Interest in the area has been amplified by the possibility of oil and natural gas reserves beneath the East China Sea.

Chinese government vessels frequently operate near the islands, although approaches to Japanese fishing boats are comparatively rare. Chinese coast guard ships were last reported to have entered waters claimed by Japan on June 10.

The latest incident comes against a backdrop of  increasingly strained ties between the two countries .

In November 2025, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said her country could come to Taiwan's aid militarily in the event of a Chinese invasion.

These comments drew heavy criticism from Beijing. Since November, Chinese officials have called on their citizens to avoid traveling to Japan and have banned Japanese entities from receiving Chinese exports, including rare earth minerals.

This incident reminds us of the constant effort required from all parties to de-escalate and seek pathways for peaceful coexistence, even amidst territorial disputes.

title.en: China sentences official to death for taking $325m in bribes
title.zh: 中国因受贿3.25亿美元判处官员死刑

summary.en: The 69-year-old helped companies secure valuable contracts in exchange for money, a court heard.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A court in eastern China has sentenced a former city official to death for taking more than 2.2bn yuan ($325m; £243m) in bribes over 30 years.

Yang Youlin, who served in various positions in Nanjing city from 1993 to 2023, was also convicted of embezzlement, abuse of power and money laundering, with his ill-gotten gains amounting to one of the highest in recent years.

The 69-year-old exploited his roles to help others secure engineering contracts, land transfers and financing, in exchange for money and valuables, said state media.

Yang was investigated as part of President Xi Jinping's anti-corruption crackdown which has cut through military ranks and high-level banking, among other sectors.

Yang, who spent much of his career working on economic and technological development in Nanjing, had committed offences "of an extremely serious nature" and "caused exceptionally heavy losses to the interests of the state and the people", a court in Changzhou city said on Monday.

Since coming to power, President Xi has launched waves of anti-corruption drives, which critics say have also been used as a tool to purge political rivals.

Death sentences for white collar crimes however remain rare, though they are meted out occasionally, typically if the cases involve large sums exceeding 1bn yuan.

For instance, former finance chief Lai Xiaomin was executed in 2021 for taking 1.8bn yuan in bribes over a 10-year period.

Li Jianping, a former Inner Mongolia official, was executed in 2024 for embezzling and taking bribes totaling more than 3bn yuan.

In many other cases, the courts handed out jail terms or suspended death sentences, which get commuted to life imprisonment after a specified duration.

The courts have also reduced sentences in some cases where the convicted individuals reported on other offenders.

But while Yang provided similar assistance to authorities, his offences were so "grave" that his assistance "was insufficient to warrant a more lenient punishment", the Changzhou court said.

Yang pleaded guilty and "expressed remorse in his final statement", according to state media.
body.zh: 中国东部一家法院判处一名前市政府官员死刑，罪名是在 30 年间收受超过 22 亿元人民币（3.25 亿美元；2.43 亿英镑）的贿赂。 1993年至2023年在南京市担任多个职务的杨友林也被判犯有贪污罪、滥用职权罪和洗钱罪，其违法所得为近年来最高的数额之一。 官方媒体称，这位 69 岁的老人利用自己的角色帮助他人获得工程合同、土地转让和融资，以换取金钱和贵重物品。 杨先生受到调查是习近平主席反腐败行动的一部分，该行动已渗透到军队和银行高层等部门。 常州市一家法院周一表示，杨先生的大部分职业生涯都在南京从事经济技术开发工作，其犯罪行为“性质极其严重”，“给国家和人民利益造成特别重大损失”。 自上台以来，习近平主席发起了一系列反腐败运动，批评者称，这也被用作清除政治对手的工具。 然而，白领犯罪被判处死刑的情况仍然很少，尽管偶尔会被判处死刑，通常是在案件涉及金额超过 10 亿元人民币的情况下。 例如，前财政部长赖小民因在 10 年间收受 18 亿元人民币贿赂，于 2021 年被处决。 内蒙古前官员李建平因贪污、受贿总额超过30亿元于2024年被执行死刑。 在许多其他案件中，法院判处监禁或缓期执行死刑，在指定期限后减刑为无期徒刑。 在某些被定罪者举报其他罪犯的案件中，法院还减轻了刑罚。 常州法院表示，虽然杨向当局提供了类似的协助，但他的罪行非常“严重”，以至于他的协助“不足以给予更轻的处罚”。 据官方媒体报道，杨承认有罪，并“在最后陈述中表达了悔意”。

title.en: Can China repeat its EV success with robotaxis?
title.zh: 中国能否在机器人出租车领域复制其电动汽车的成功？

summary.en: China's self-driving car firms have been given a headstart by the country's EV supply chain as they expand globally.
summary.zh: 中国的自动驾驶汽车公司正利用该国现有的电动汽车供应链优势，在全球范围内拓展业务。

body.en:
In Beijing's Yizhuang district, driverless vehicles have become a common sight. Robotaxis weave through traffic alongside ordinary cars, while autonomous delivery vans glide along the inside lane as they carry packages to collection points.

The district has become one of China's testing grounds for autonomous driving, with companies including Baidu, WeRide and Pony.ai operating commercial robotaxi services within designated areas.

Booking a ride requires little more than opening an app. Within minutes, a robotaxi pulls up with nobody behind the wheel. After confirming the journey on a touchscreen, the vehicle merges into Beijing's dense traffic, navigating buses, cyclists, scooters and pedestrians with little hesitation.

The technology is still evolving. But a bigger question now looms: can Chinese companies turn robotaxis into another sector they dominate globally, as they have with electric vehicles (EVs)?

China's autonomous driving companies already have a powerful advantage - the industrial ecosystem that helped turn the country into the world's largest EV market.

Unlike Tesla, which designs much of its technology in-house, China's self-driving industry is built around a network of companies.

Established carmakers including BYD, Chery, Geely, and SAIC build the cars, while specialist firms develop the software.

Autonomous vehicles rely on many of the same batteries, sensors, chips and onboard computers as electric cars.

Because those supply chains already exist at enormous scale, companies can develop technology faster and at a lower cost.

"What you see is a pace of innovation and adaptation in the Chinese EV industry that I don't think is matched anywhere else around the world," says Kyle Chan, a foreign policy fellow at the Brookings Institution.

"China's EV capacity doesn't just stop there. It actually spills over into other related industries through something that I call these overlapping tech industrial ecosystems."

Government policy has also played a role. Pilot programmes in several cities allow companies to test the technology on some public roads.

But China also offers something else to firms that are trying to make the technology smarter: complex driving conditions.

A single journey through Beijing can require an autonomous vehicle to deal with buses, scooters, cyclists, pedestrians and unpredictable traffic.

"The traffic environment here in China is very complex," Maeve Zhang, chief marketing officer at WeRide, told the BBC.

That diversity of road users generates vast amounts of data to help improve software.

Although driving data from China is useful, there are other challenging conditions abroad which could hinder any rapid expansion in overseas markets.

body.zh: 在北京亦庄区，无人驾驶汽车已成为常见现象。机器人出租车与普通汽车并肩穿梭在交通中，而自动送货车则沿着内侧车道滑行，将包裹运送到收集点。 该区已成为中国自动驾驶试验场之一，百度、文远知行、小马智行等公司在指定区域内运营商业机器人出租车服务。 预订乘车只需打开应用程序即可。几分钟之内，一辆无人出租车就停了下来。在触摸屏上确认行程后，车辆融入北京拥挤的交通，毫不犹豫地引导公交车、自行车、踏板车和行人。 该技术仍在不断发展。但现在出现了一个更大的问题：中国企业能否将机器人出租车转变为他们在全球主导的另一个领域，就像他们在电动汽车（EV）领域所做的那样？ 中国的自动驾驶公司已经拥有强大的优势——产业生态系统，帮助中国成为全球最大的电动汽车市场。 与特斯拉自行设计大部分技术不同，中国的自动驾驶行业是围绕公司网络建立的。 包括比亚迪、奇瑞、吉利和上汽在内的老牌汽车制造商生产汽车，而专业公司则开发软件。 自动驾驶汽车依赖许多与电动汽车相同的电池、传感器、芯片和车载计算机。 由于这些供应链已经大规模存在，公司可以更快、更低成本地开发技术。 布鲁金斯学会外交政策研究员凯尔·陈 (Kyle Chan) 表示：“你看到的是中国电动汽车行业的创新和适应步伐，我认为这是世界其他任何地方都无法比拟的。” “中国的电动汽车产能并不止于此。它实际上通过我称之为重叠科技产业生态系统的东西溢出到其他相关行业。” 政府政策也发挥了作用。多个城市的试点项目允许公司在一些公共道路上测试该技术。 但中国还为那些试图让技术变得更加智能的公司提供了其他东西：复杂的驾驶条件。 穿越北京的一次旅程可能需要一辆自动驾驶汽车来应对公共汽车、踏板车、骑自行车的人、行人和不可预测的交通。 “中国的交通环境非常复杂，”文远知行首席营销官 Maeve 张 告诉 BBC。 道路使用者的多样性会产生大量数据来帮助改进软件。 尽管来自中国的驱动数据很有用，但国外还存在其他具有挑战性的条件，可能会阻碍海外市场的快速扩张。 “在中东，气温非常高。在南部......

This surge in innovation, from EV supply chains to autonomous vehicles, reflects humanity's ongoing capacity for discovery. title.en: How do Australia's 'great deals' with its neighbours compare to China?
title.zh: 澳大利亚与邻国的“大交易”与中国相比如何？

summary.en: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is strengthening diplomatic and economic ties with Pacific island nations, a region where China has significant influence.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯正在加强与太平洋岛国的外交和经济关系，该地区是中国具有重要影响力的区域。

body.en:
Anthony Albanese is turning his attention to the Solomon Islands after securing Australia a major new defence agreement with Fiji, as he seeks to shore up support against the expansion of Chinese influence in the region.

Albanese and Fijian Prime Minister Sitiveni Rabuka formalised the Ocean of Peace Alliance alongside an updated Vuvale Union partnership during a ceremony in the Fijian capital Suva on Monday.

Albanese hailed the treaties, aimed at strengthening regional security amid intensifying strategic competition in the Pacific, as "one of the most significant endeavours Australia has undertaken with any country".

Fiji is one of Australia's closest Pacific security partners and has one of the region's largest militaries, making the agreement one of Canberra's most noteworthy in the Pacific.

The visit to Suva is part of a days-long diplomatic mission during which Albanese will meet with several regional leaders including Solomon Islands counterpart Matthew Wale for a whistle-stop tour on Tuesday, with the focus on a new comprehensive treaty.

The leaders last week agreed to start talks on a treaty to "capture the two countries' joint ambition for the relationship".

This latest push from Albanese comes as China confirmed on Monday it successfully tested a submarine-launched ballistic missile carried by a strategic nuclear submarine in international waters in the Pacific Ocean.

The agreements with Fiji expand the two nations' long-standing security and development relationship and introduce a mutual defence commitment.

The new Ocean of Peace Alliance commits both countries to consult and respond to security developments that threaten the sovereignty, peace or stability of either nation.

"Each Party recognises that an armed attack on any of the Parties within the Pacific would be dangerous to each other's peace and security as well as the security of the Pacific, and declares that it would act to meet the common danger, in accordance with its domestic processes," the deal reads.

Australia will support the partnership with more than $1 billion in funding over the next decade, targeting transnational crime prevention and investing in education, healthcare, and infrastructure projects in Fiji.

Australia works with all 14 Pacific Island nations to varying degrees, and has major security agreements with Papua New Guinea, Fiji, Solomon Islands, Vanuatu, Tuvalu and Nauru.

It also cooperates with other nations in the region, from foreign aid and infrastructure funding to marine surveillance and peacekeeping.

Henry Ivarature, a Pacific fellow with the Australia Pacific Security College at the Australian...
body.zh: 在澳大利亚与斐济达成一项重要的新防务协议后，安东尼·阿尔巴内塞将注意力转向所罗门群岛，寻求支持反对中国在该地区扩张的影响力。 阿尔巴尼亚和斐济总理西蒂维尼·拉布卡周一在斐济首都苏瓦举行的仪式上正式成立了和平海洋联盟，并更新了武瓦莱联盟伙伴关系。 阿尔巴尼斯称赞这些旨在在太平洋地区战略竞争加剧的情况下加强地区安全的条约是“澳大利亚与任何国家所做的最重要的努力之一”。 斐济是澳大利亚最亲密的太平洋安全伙伴之一，并拥有该地区最大的军队之一，这使得该协议成为堪培拉在太平洋地区最值得关注的协议之一。 对苏瓦的访问是为期几天的外交访问的一部分，在此期间，阿尔巴内斯将于周二与包括所罗门群岛同行马修·韦尔在内的几位地区领导人进行短暂停留，重点讨论一项新的全面条约。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 两国领导人上周同意开始就一项条约进行谈判，以“体现两国对两国关系的共同抱负”。 阿尔巴尼斯提出这一最新举措之际，中国周一证实在太平洋国际水域成功试射了一艘战略核潜艇携带的潜射弹道导弹。 与斐济的协议扩大了两国长期的安全和发展关系，并引入了共同防御承诺。 新的和平海洋联盟要求两国就威胁两国主权、和平或稳定的安全事态发展进行磋商和做出反应。 协议中写道：“各方认识到，对太平洋地区任何一方的武装攻击将危及彼此的和平与安全以及太平洋地区的安全，并宣布将根据其国内程序采取行动应对共同危险。” 澳大利亚将在未来十年内提供超过 10 亿美元的资金支持这一伙伴关系，旨在预防跨国犯罪，并投资于斐济的教育、医疗保健和基础设施项目。 澳大利亚与所有 14 个太平洋岛国都有不同程度的合作，并与巴布亚新几内亚、斐济、所罗门群岛、瓦努阿图、图瓦卢和瑙鲁签署了重大安全协议。 它还与该地区其他国家合作，从对外援助和基础设施资金到海洋监视和维和。 亨利·伊瓦拉图（Henry Ivarature）是澳大利亚太平洋安全学院的太平洋研究员。

title.en: 'Destabilising': Australia criticises China after ballistic missile test launch in the Pacific
title.zh: “破坏稳定”：澳大利亚批评中国在太平洋进行弹道导弹试验

summary.en: Australia has criticized China following a ballistic missile test launch in the Pacific, describing the action as "destabilising." This test marks China's latest intercontinental ballistic missile launch in 2024.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚批评中国在太平洋地区进行弹道导弹试射，称此举“破坏稳定”。这是中国在2024年进行的最新一次洲际弹道导弹试验。

body.en:
Australia and New Zealand have sounded the alarm after China confirmed it successfully tested a ballistic missile carried by a strategic nuclear submarine in international waters in the Pacific Ocean.

Chinese state media Xinhua reported that the testing is part of China's annual military exercise, and it had alerted relevant countries in advance, in accordance with international law.

Xinhua described the launch as a "routine arrangement" of China's annual military training and said it was not directed against any specific country or target.

This comes after Australia and Fiji signed a major defence alliance earlier in the day, committing each country to come to the other's aid in case either is attacked.

Foreign Minister Penny Wong said the Australian government had been advised in advance by China of the test.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Australia has been clear with China that we regard this as destabilising to the region," she told reporters on Monday, moments before the launch was confirmed.

"This proposed test is in the context of a rapid military buildup by China, which is lacking in the transparency and reassurance as to intent that the region expects."

Wong said the test was "inconsistent" with Pacific leaders' requests for the ocean to be one "of peace".

"It appears that, despite our long-standing concerns about this type of activity, China carried out the test within hours of informing us," he said in a statement.

"The Pacific is an Ocean of Peace and we are deeply concerned by China's testing of nuclear-capable weapons into the South Pacific."

Japan's government said it had been notified of the missile launch and urged China to reconsider.

"We expressed our grave concern over the Chinese military's increased activity," Tokyo said, adding that Japan's Coast Guard had been notified on Sunday by Chinese authorities about falling space debris that could fall within Japan's exclusive economic zone.

Japan's Kyodo news agency on Monday reported, citing a Japanese government source, that the missile had landed outside Japan's EEZ.

China's elite Rocket Force fired a dummy warhead into the sea near French Polynesia in September 2024, its first long-range missile launch over international waters in more than 40 years.

body.zh: 在中国确认在太平洋国际水域成功试射战略核潜艇携带的弹道导弹后，澳大利亚和新西兰敲响了警钟。 中国官方媒体新华社报道称，此次测试是中国年度军事演习的一部分，并已根据国际法提前向有关国家发出警报。 新华社称此次发射是中国年度军事训练的“例行安排”，不针对任何特定国家或目标。 此前，澳大利亚和斐济当天早些时候签署了一项主要防务联盟，承诺两国在任何一方受到攻击时向对方提供援助。 外交部长黄英贤表示，中国已提前向澳大利亚政府通报了这次试验。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “澳大利亚已经向中国明确表示，我们认为这会破坏该地区的稳定，”她周一在发射确认前不久对记者表示。 “这项拟议的测试是在中国迅速增强军力的背景下进行的，而中国缺乏该地区所期望的透明度和保证。” 黄说，这次测试与太平洋领导人要求海洋成为“和平海洋”的要求“不一致”。 他在一份声明中表示：“看来，尽管我们长期以来对此类活动感到担忧，但中国在通知我们后几小时内就进行了这次试验。” “太平洋是和平之海，我们对中国在南太平洋进行核武器试验深表关切。” 日本政府表示已收到导弹发射的通知，并敦促中国重新考虑。 东京表示：“我们对中国军方增加的活动表示严重关切。”他补充说，中国当局已于周日通知日本海岸警卫队，称坠落的太空碎片可能落入日本专属经济区内。 日本共同社周一援引日本政府消息人士的话报道称，这枚导弹降落在日本专属经济区之外。 2024 年 9 月，中国精锐火箭军向法属波利尼西亚附近海域发射了一枚模拟弹头，这是 40 多年来首次在国际水域发射远程导弹。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。
